name: SN 2019com field (Hubble)
blurb: SN 2019com field, the site of a Type II supernova, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2019comfield-hubble
story: Hubble looked back at the place where SN 2019com, a Type II supernova, exploded. Late snapshots like this probe what the blast left behind and the gas that surrounded the doomed star.

claims.text: SN 2019com is a Type II supernova
SN 2019com showed prominent hydrogen-alpha emission typical of Type II supernovae
Program 16239 takes late-time snapshots of nearby recent supernovae to measure radioactive material and circumstellar environments
